title: BIM Detailer
purpose: Specialized production and interoperability role responsible for governed BIM output readiness. Executes standardized, repeatable, high-precision production tasks, interoperability workflows, content/parameter operations, pre-publish QA checks, and pooled production capacity across projects so models are deliverable-ready.
authority_statements: Execute governed production tasks assigned through governed intake
Execute interoperability and exchange workflows between tools
Execute pre-publish QA and readiness checks
Propose fixes and request clarifications on model health
Reject pre-publish model states that fail governed QA checklists
May not override BEP rules or acceptance criteria
May not redefine standards or workflows
May not bypass coordination or governance
responsibilities: Build, refine, and adjust model geometry, families, annotation, and views through governed intake
Prepare and execute governed exports/imports between tools applying approved exchange settings
Package models, views, and data for coordination, review, or submission
Apply shared parameters, execute mass parameter updates, and audit parameter completeness
Maintain reusable content libraries with version notes and placement rules
Execute pre-publish checklists for naming, structure, views, parameters, and exchange readiness
Record QA evidence (reports, logs) in CDE
Investigate model health issues using governed methods and escalate systemic failures
Operate pooled multi-project production capacity following default priority order (Safety -> Submittals -> Blockers -> Hygiene)
accountabilities: Technical readiness and compliance of pre-publish models and exchange packages
Accuracy and completeness of parameter audits and QA evidence logs
Disciplined execution of pooled production dispatch tasks
approvals: Readiness clearance for pre-publish models passing QA checks (decides what is ready, not what is acceptable)
inputs: Governed intake task requests via dispatch
Raw models requiring exchange packaging or parameter population
Pre-publish QA checklist rules from Project BIM Manager
outputs: Deliverable-ready model updates and detailed geometry
Governed exchange packages (IFC, NWC, DWG, RVT)
QA validation reports and audit logs in CDE
Parameter audit outputs and mass-populated models

provenance.migration_note: Role definition migrated from the extracted governed role corpus and normalized according to accepted curator decisions.

curator_scope.pre_publish: Executes governed objective checks and may reject failing states; does not grant contractual or governance acceptance.
